title: Generic finite pushforward is constructible
statement: Let $S$ be an integral Noetherian affine scheme, let $g:Z\to S$ be finite, and let $E$ be a constructible abelian etale sheaf on $Z$. There is a dense open $S^\circ\subset S$ on which the direct image $g_*E$ is lisse.

proof.text: Apply the finite-source generic-lissity theorem to the constructible sheaf E, obtaining a dense open U where the underlying abelian restriction to g^{-1}(U) is lisse.
Independently apply the generic preservation theorem to the finite map g, obtaining a dense open V on which direct image preserves lissity over every smaller open.

Take W=U intersect V. The intersection is dense by Dense.inter_of_isOpen_left. The inclusion g^{-1}(W) into g^{-1}(U) is the map Z.homOfLE of the inclusion of opens. Apply pullback_finite_locally_constant to this inclusion and (g^{-1}(U)).ι. Rewrite the composite inclusion using Scheme.homOfLE_ι to obtain lissity of the exact abelian restriction to g^{-1}(W).

Since W is contained in V, apply the preservation property over W to E and the just-proved lissity of its source restriction. This yields the exact underlying set restriction of g_*E required by the target declaration.
